FUSILLI PICNIC SALAN
Serves: 6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients
= ask for this at our deli counter!

Salad:

Ya cup Grect marinated
artichokes, drained and thinly
sliced™® =
I cup Kalamata Olives, pitied
and halved*
[7 cup yellow tomatoes, halved
6oz feta, cubed
72 cup thinly sliced red onion
7a cup chopped fresh dill
7a cup chopped fresh mint
V2 cup toasted pine nuts
Dressing:
6 Thsp extra-virgin olive oil*
3 Thsp sherry vinegar
[Tbsp fresh orange juice
1 2 tsp whole grain mustard
I garlic clove, crushed
72 tsp sumac
salt and pepper to taste
pinch of sugar

Directions
I. Boil the fusilli in salted water until just tender.
2. Tip into a colander and run under the cold
tap, then shake well and leave to
dry off ~~
3. Shake the dressing
ingredients together in a jar (olive oil, vinegar.
orange juice, mustard, garlic,
-sumac, salt, pepper, and
sugar)
4.Ina wide bowl tumble the
drained fusilli with the marinated
artichokes, olives. yellow tomatoes,
feta, red onion, dill,
and mint
5. Spoon the dressing over the pasta
and turn until everything shines
6. Scatter with pine nuts, taste, and
fix the salt if you need to
7. Chill for 20- 30 minutes
before Servs
